package_info.why_malicious: The report does not analyze or present any specific malicious package or code. Instead, it provides high-level statistics and trends regarding the prevalence of malicious packages and vulnerabilities in open source ecosystems. No particular package, version, or code sample is identified as malicious in this report.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: This report does not provide technical details, code-level indicators, or specific IOCs for detecting malware. It emphasizes the importance of using up-to-date, non-vulnerable component versions, monitoring for unmaintained projects, and being aware of the prevalence of malicious packages in open source ecosystems. Recommended detection strategies include automated vulnerability scanning, dependency management, and monitoring for abnormal package behaviors, but no actionable code, behavioral signatures, or indicators are provided in the report.
